notes: Labour hours per unit of the estimate rules (data/rules/de_residential_din276.json). Every value was read on the page named by source.url on the retrieved date and is quoted verbatim (elisions marked ...). A rule without an open published value has labour_h_per_unit null and a missing reason: it gets no activity and is flagged rate_missing, never a guessed duration. Where the source gives a range, low and high are kept and 'use' says which end the plan uses. The logic block (order of trades, storey by storey) is a planning assumption, not sourced data.
